[!assets] skip 'requires embedded web assets'

exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-18T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix web-

# Production builds reject development-only syntax before opening a store.
! exec card web --dev
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/dev-error.txt

# Release mode serves Connect and the browser application on one listener.
exec sh probe-web.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/probe.txt
cmpjson bootstrap-stable.json $WORK/golden/bootstrap.json
cmp missing.status $WORK/golden/missing-status.txt
cmp missing.body $WORK/golden/missing-body.txt

-- probe-web.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

card web --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --no-browser >web.out 2>web.err &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

i=0
url=
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  url=$(sed -n 's/^web application available at //p' web.out | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$url" ] && break
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done
[ -n "$url" ]

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  if curl --fail --silent --request POST \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --header 'Connect-Protocol-Version: 1' \
    --data '{}' \
    "$url/cardamom.private.v1.ProjectService/GetBootstrap" >bootstrap.json; then
    break
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done

jq 'del(.sources[].source.storeLineageId)' bootstrap.json >bootstrap-stable.json

curl --fail --silent "$url/" >shell.body
grep '<div id="app"></div>' shell.body >/dev/null
curl --fail --silent \
  "$url/board/board_00000000000000000000/issue/web-1" >spa.body
cmp shell.body spa.body

curl --silent --output missing.body --write-out '%{http_code}\n' \
  "$url/assets/missing.js" >missing.status

kill -TERM "$pid"
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT
echo 'web probe passed'

-- golden/bootstrap.json --
